ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(PrecoListaTotal__c), ISCHANGED(Amount) ), AND( TEXT(StatusAprovacao__c) <> "Precisa de Aprovação", NecessitaAprovacao__c = TRUE ), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(StatusAprovacao__c))), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Distribuidor", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Licitacao_Direta", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Licitacao_Indireta", RecordType.DeveloperName = "OEM", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Purchasing_Group", RecordType.DeveloperName = "VendaDireta", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Samples" ) )
